verdict.rationale: The evidence shows `fly launch` can create, configure, and deploy an app, and Machines can be managed through a CLI and REST API. None of it mentions a declarative configuration file that defines the whole architecture or can be version-controlled, so there is no direct support for this applicable deploy-workflow axis.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define, deploy, and version my entire architecture with a single configuration file
